component.name: Ajazz Linux
component.summary: Unofficial settings for the AJAZZ AJ199 mouse

description.p: DPI stages and colors, button assignments, macros and the scroll wheel light for the AJAZZ AJ199 mouse, with desktop notifications when the DPI stage changes and when the battery is low.
Unofficial and not affiliated with the manufacturer. Writes to the mouse were checked by hand on a single unit, so treat this preview as experimental.
